title: Group payment confirmation observed after expiration
description: This event occurs when a group-payment confirmation carries an effective payment date on or before the covered quote's expiration date, but the worker only observes/processes that confirmation after the quote has already expired.

org_id.title: Org ID
org_id.description: Organization/tenant ID. Organization associated with authorization.

payment_id.title: Payment ID
payment_id.description: Group payment/quote ID that this confirmation is associated with

tracking_id.title: Tracking ID
tracking_id.description: Authorization tracking ID for the confirmation that triggered this observation

effective_payment_date.title: Effective payment date
effective_payment_date.description: Effective payment date supplied on the incoming authorization (UTC calendar day), on or before the quote expiration date

quote_expiration_date.title: Quote expiration date
quote_expiration_date.description: Expiration date of the group-payment quote covered by this confirmation

observed_at.title: Observed at
observed_at.description: Timestamp when the worker observed/evaluated this confirmation, in UTC. ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 format: `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.sssZ`

payment_status.title: Payment status
payment_status.description: Status of the group payment at the moment this confirmation was observed. Context only - not part of the trigger condition for this event. Common values include PENDING and EXPIRED (reflecting whether the expiration job has run yet) and CONFIRMED (on a redelivered confirmation already fully processed by an earlier attempt), but the field is not restricted to a fixed set.
